videos.name: Rough Seas on Royal Caribbean's Vision of the Seas
videos.description:
!!Subscribe for more content like this!!
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCmTwsd2YTjS9xykmScB_SrA?sub_confirmation=1

While we are on a Royal Caribbean cruise on the Vision of the Seas, we ran into a little weather. I should say that the video makes this look worse than it was, I was having a blast during all this and the crew was amazing. Very professional helping keep everyone safe. I just wanted to share a little of the video I captured during the rough waves.

videos.name: A Tour around Key West, Florida
videos.description: This is just a quick video of us looking around Key West, Florida when we were in port. We did not do an excursion just spent some time driving around town. It is definitely a place I want to visit again!

videos.name: Tour Nassau, Bahamas
videos.description: This is a short video of our trip around Nassau, Bahamas. We were in port on a Royal Caribbean Cruise and spent some time touring around town. Our cruise ship was the Vision of the Seas. I hope you enjoy our little trip around Nassau.
